verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list ARM CPU support and name Apple Silicon among its hardware plugins, so the product claims some Apple Silicon support. That evidence is one list entry with no detail, and Apple Silicon comes through a plugin rather than the core engine. Missing for 10: any evidence of Metal/GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon, documentation of the Apple Silicon plugin's install and performance, Apple-specific ARM optimizations, and independent or hands-on benchmarks.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs. Additionally, diverse hardware plugins such as Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, Rebellions NPU, Apple Silicon, MetaX GPU, and more.
